theorems.name: Submission.intcpt_ri_restrict_similarity_image
theorems.statement: ∀ (N n : ℕ) (ξ : Euclidean N) (t : ℝ) (A : Set (Euclidean N)), 0 < t → (μHE[n] : Measure (Euclidean N)).restrict ((fun y : Euclidean N ↦ ξ + t • y) '' A) = ENNReal.ofReal (t ^ n) • ((μHE[n] : Measure (Euclidean N)).restrict A).map (fun y : Euclidean N ↦ ξ + t • y)
